non_negotiables.world_priority: world-dominant; landscape and architecture carry the frame

camera.projection_feel: third-person/isometric-adjacent but perspective-rich, never flat orthographic

requirements: volumetric light or equivalent painterly shafts

characters.proportions: grounded adult human proportions unless creature/species canon says otherwise
readability: rim/value separation when background demands it
class/equipment identity readable at gameplay scale

requirements: localized magical emissive light without neon wash

ui.mobile: controls may be minimal translucent overlays; no giant flat gray slabs

forbidden: primitive geometric placeholder environments presented as final
solid black rectangular HUD boxes dominating the screen
one character image reused for exploration battle and dialogue
untextured geometry presented as production art
low-detail silhouettes that cannot survive comparison with source references

acceptance.visual_review: A functional asset that violates this constitution fails production acceptance.
